lines.text: Ahab asks Naboth the Jezreelite for his vineyard next to the palace, but Naboth refuses because it is his fathers' inheritance.
Jezebel asks why Ahab refuses to eat, then promises to get him the vineyard of Naboth.
Jezebel writes letters in Ahab's name to the elders, telling them to seat two priests opposite Naboth to accuse him.
The LORD tells Elijah the Tishbite to meet Ahab and say that dogs will lick up his blood.
Ahab tears his clothes and puts on armor, so the LORD says the calamity will come in his son's days.
